title: Critical: User Auth ID Mismatch - Progress Data Not Displayed
description: User etan@heyman.net has progress data (76 records) stored under userId k572fk152njnp9g621kc64bq4x7zgbyt, but getAuthUserId() returns jd7cr3fr0jv8637xeykwftw91h7zn9nv (app users table ID). Queries return empty because IDs don't match.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Identify root cause: progress data uses Better Auth ID, but getAuthUserId returns app users ID
Fix: Update all progress data to use app users._id instead of Better Auth ID
Migrate wordProgress records from userId k572fk152njnp9g621kc64bq4x7zgbyt to jd7cr3fr0jv8637xeykwftw91h7zn9nv
Verify: Login as etan@heyman.net shows dashboard with progress data

notes:
ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS:

1. Old system used Better Auth user._id directly as userId in progress tables
2. Data was migrated with userId = k572fk152njnp9g621kc64bq4x7zgbyt (Better Auth ID)
3. BUG-024 fix created separate app users table with _id = jd7cr3fr0jv8637xeykwftw91h7zn9nv
4. getAuthUserId() now returns app users._id, not Better Auth ID
5. Queries for userId = jd7cr3fr0jv8637xeykwftw91h7zn9nv find nothing!

FIX APPROACH:
Migrate all progress data from old userId to new userId:
- FROM: k572fk152njnp9g621kc64bq4x7zgbyt (Better Auth ID)
- TO: jd7cr3fr0jv8637xeykwftw91h7zn9nv (app users._id)

AFFECTED TABLES:
- wordProgress (65 records)
- lineProgress (6 records)
- userSongProgress (1 record)
- userWishlist (1 record)
- userPracticeLog (2 records)
- userPreferences (1 record)

TOTAL: 76 records to migrate

MIGRATION COMPLETED:
Used oneTimeMigration:migrateVisitorIdToUserId to migrate 76 records from visitorId=k572fk152njnp9g621kc64bq4x7zgbyt to userId=jd7cr3fr0jv8637xeykwftw91h7zn9nv. Verified via checkUserData query that all data is now accessible under the correct userId.
